info.title: Seller Ops Go Screening API
info.description: Go 服务。浏览器使用 /api/ecom/screening 同源代理；内部路径须通过带工作区及角色的 HMAC 身份校验。商品参数在主表，价格销量在月份副表。 SellerSprite imports retain every raw column. Structured product attributes are stored in ps_products, operating columns in ps_product_monthly, and source FBA/gross-margin snapshots in ps_profit_scenarios with record_kind=imported. Source estimates are not calculated profits.

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: 自然月、滚动30天或自定义；指定月份时默认自然月

parameters.description: 最低子体销量参考值，仅返回已知值达到门槛的商品，不使用父体销量补全
